notes.title: NEW on Steam: Trading Cards, Emoticons, Badges, & Backgrounds
notes.notes: [p]Players can now unlock trading cards just by playing Sandboxels on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/226b054a5f24691ad07907d8fca496bd380e153d.png"][/img][/p][p]A card drops every 30 minutes of playtime. Collect the whole set and craft the cards into a badge, emoticon, and profile background![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/2e3b5c7b8fde2bdaa03952d8ff8a5698c5bc9f54.png"][/img][/p][p]You can also use Steam Points to buy the emotes.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Sandboxels v1.12 - Saves For All - OUT NOW
notes.notes: [p]This may have been the longest update to develop so far! It brings anticipated online features to the Steam Edition, along with many features for the web version, too![/p][p][/p][h1]🎨 Save Browsing 💾[/h1][p]There are now multiple ways to browse and load community-made canvases! Select one of the new tabs of the Saves menu:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/3a2acc3294aabb7694d9b427c7e21cf40c568bf3.png"][/img][/p][p]Try our curated selection in the “Featured” tab. These have no mods enabled and should work for all players![/p][p][/p][p]The “Discord” tab allows you to browse, search, and filter saves posted in our [url="https://discord.gg/ejUc6YPQuS"]Discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, for those with the Steam Edition… Sandboxels now fully supports the Steam Workshop! You can publish saves right from the game for everyone to immediately try out.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/1a88e9ddae250e0062f217a662932d57e3d899fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]🎮 More Steam Features 💨[/h1][p]In addition to Workshop support, Sandboxels now has a dedicated data folder on your computer, similar to other games.[/p][p][/p][p]This folder has subfolders for locally-stored saves and mods. The saves can be managed directly in-game — no more slots![/p][p][/p][p]Discord Rich Presence support has also been added, which displays details about your canvas on your profile, such as your selected element and pixel count.[/p][p][/p][p]If your Steam client has another language selected, Sandboxels will try to enable translations automatically. The game version number and element counts from the web version are now also shown.[/p][p][/p][h1]🧪 New Elements 🔥[/h1][p]Two new elements are ready to meet you![/p][p][/p][p]Lye is a versatile powder made from Sodium-based reactions. It can be used to produce Soap, Bleach, and Methane. It can even un-galvanize Galvanized Steel![/p][p][/p][p]Invar is a dark metal alloy, made by melting Iron with Nickel.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/3d44aacd9be13eb90b8c85d7ef1296af642f18c8.png"][/img][/p][h1]☔️ Streak View 🧐[/h1][p]A new view mode?!?! That’s right, press the [i]4[/i] key on your keyboard to select Streak View.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/b6833383ff97293949a8fdbf3d29b4895f354a45.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This will leave a trail behind all moving pixels, which will fade over time, creating interesting spectacles like this rain below.[/p][p][/p][h1]🌽 Small But Neat 🌈[/h1][p]Here’s a quick rundown of some other new features to try out![/p][list][*][p]Buttons now have a smooth clicking animation[/p][/*][*][p]Corn is now affected by gravity (Wow!)[/p][/*][*][p]Many metals have been recolored, creating some unique element colors[/p][/*][*][p]Sand can be dyed into Color Sand of the same hue[/p][/*][*][p]Melting Glass with certain elements, like Gold, will create Stained Glass (Discover them all!)[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on an empty Cloner will set its element — no need to actually place it![/p][/*][/list][p]There were over 140 changes, including 19 bug fixes! [b]Read the [url="https://sandboxels.r74n.com/changelog"]FULL CHANGELOG[/url][/b].[/p][p][/p][h1]😌 Phew…[/h1][p][/p][p]Try out the new update now![/p][p][/p][p]We have a lot more planned around R74n in the coming months. Please enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Sandboxels OUT ON STEAM + New Update (v1.11.2)
notes.notes:
Sandboxels has officially been released on Steam! To celebrate, we also have a new update (v1.11.2) with some small but neat features!

[h1]♨️ CHECK STEAM ♨️[/h1]

The Steam edition of Sandboxels can be picked up now for under a dollar! And even better: For a limited time, it’s 40% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/d0a088a6e4d063e2b310122a5416606175408f10.png[/img]

It comes with fancy lighting pre-installed!

Don’t want it yet? Put in on your wishlist to support us for free!

[h1]🆕 THE UPDATE 🆕[/h1]

This update has many small but fun features!

First, we added a new set of themes that you can select from. Each one is based on an element in Sandboxels! Below you can see the Brick theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/8c1ba5576384118bbea03932892f52978c5389d5.png[/img]

Themes include the default Dark, Fire, Juice, Plant, Steam, Water, Plasma, and Snow – which is the equivalent of a light mode.

Additionally, we made the backgrounds of menus translucent, so you can see what’s going on behind them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589968/ec3d5cb5938e829bc6c15c75582fd6646b131495.png[/img]

We also added a new “Destroyable” border mode, where your canvas is surrounded by a layer of Glass, and greater support for Korean, Italian, Serbian, and Australian English.

Be sure to view the full changelog for technical changes and bug fixes.

[h1]🕰️ What’s Next? 🕰️[/h1]

So far, the Steam release is only a port of Sandboxels. However, the next update will include unique online integrations with Steam, potentially with a Workshop save browser. Once you purchase Sandboxels on Steam, you are guaranteed to receive these features when they launch!

The web version of Sandboxels will continue to receive free updates!

If you haven’t already, please [url=https://www.youtube.com/@R74n?sub_confirmation=1]subscribe to us on YouTube[/url]! We’re almost at 100,000 subscribers.

[url=https://news.r74n.com/](Originally posted on the R74n Newsletter)[/url]
